title: Una década de contrastes
goal: Read a closing synthesis of the 1990s' uneven outcomes -- Chile's stability, the crises elsewhere, and the persistent inequality that CEPAL documented across the region.

items: Explain why the 1990s are called a "década de contrastes."
Describe what distinguished Chile from most of its neighbors.
State what CEPAL found about regional inequality by decade's end.
Explain what this contrast set the stage for.
Use a diferencia de to introduce an explicit contrast.
